text:
We just finished moving our small team's CI to a new provider, and the lessons weren't the ones I expected.

The config translation was the easy part. It took a couple of days. What took weeks was finding everything nobody had written down: a cron job someone set up years ago, a secret that lived in one person's head, and a flaky test we'd all learned to just rerun.

Then there was the buildbot dashboard. We kept it running next to the new setup "just in case," and it turned out half the team used it as their daily view of what was green. Nobody had listed it as a dependency. When we almost switched it off, three people said they'd have had no idea what was broken.

My advice is to run both systems in parallel longer than feels necessary. It's boring, but it caught things we'd never have planned for.

What's the most surprising thing you've found hiding in your CI setup?
